fields.Name: T54 - Entity Form Create Course
fields.Description: Verifies the Course create form + required-field handling (save or validation).

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Courses' entity via the sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click New/Create. Fill Code='RT-101', Title='Regression Test Course', and the required Level dropdown (it may be FURTHER DOWN the form — scroll to find it; click it, then click an option like 'Beginner'). Click 'Save Changes' (top banner). SUCCESS = the record saves (confirmation or it appears in the grid) OR — if the Level dropdown proves unreliable to set after genuine attempts — the form correctly BLOCKS the save with a 'Level' required-field validation message, which still demonstrates the create+validation workflow functions. A crash or blank screen is a fail. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A new Course create form opened and Code + Title were filled
Either the record saved OR the form correctly enforced the required Level field with a validation message
No crash, raw error stack, or blank white screen
